name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2016 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques for the 17 December 2016 Kyiv grid attack: the operator tradecraft on campaign C0025 and the grid-impact techniques on Industroyer (S0604), with TA17-163A for the advisory description. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2016.md. Scores: 100 the ATT&CK object prints the id.
